name: MIPL AI 3D Product Gallery for WooCommerce
author: Mulika Team

sections.description:
MIPL AI 3D Product Gallery for WooCommerce allows store owners to create engaging product experiences by displaying interactive 3D models on WooCommerce product pages.

Generate 3D models using AI with credit-based generation or upload your own compatible 3D models. Customers can rotate, zoom, and inspect products from every angle before making a purchase.

Features

  • AI-powered 3D model generation
  • Interactive 360° product gallery
  • Upload your own 3D models
  • Zoom, rotate and pan controls
  • Responsive on desktop and mobile
  • WooCommerce integration
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Easy setup
  • AR support for Android and iOS devices
  • Android AR is available at no additional AI credit cost
  • iOS AR requires USDZ processing and consumes AI credits

AI Credits

AI-generated 3D models require available AI credits. Credits can be purchased when needed. Uploaded 3D models do not require AI credits.

AR Support

The plugin supports Augmented Reality (AR) on compatible Android and iOS devices.

Android: AR is available at no additional AI credit cost. Compatible Android devices can use AR through supported AR features such as Google Scene Viewer.
iOS: AR is supported through Apple Quick Look. iOS AR requires USDZ model processing, and AI credits will be deducted when the USDZ model is generated or processed for AR.
AR availability may depend on the device, browser, operating system, and AR capabilities supported by the device.

AI credits are only deducted for the applicable iOS AR USDZ processing. Using AR on supported Android devices does not deduct AI credits.

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to third-party services to provide AI-powered 3D model generation and rendering functionality.

Tripo3D AI Service

The plugin uses the MIPL 3D Model Manager service to communicate with Tripo3D AI for generating 3D models.

Service URL:
https://apps.mulika.in/mipl-3d-model-manager/

This service is used to:

  • Generate AI-powered 3D product models
  • Process generation requests
  • Retrieve generated 3D model files
  • Manage AI generation credits

Depending on your configuration, the following information may be sent:

  • Product images selected for generation
  • Generation parameters
  • Authentication token or API key (if configured)

Privacy Policy:
https://apps.mulika.in/mipl-3d-model-manager/privacy-policy/

Terms of Service:
https://apps.mulika.in/mipl-3d-model-manager/terms-and-conditions/

Google Model Viewer

This plugin uses Google’s open-source web component to render interactive 3D models.

Project:
https://modelviewer.dev/

Source Code:
https://github.com/google/model-viewer
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mipl-3d-product directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit a WooCommerce product and open the 3D Model tab in the Product data section.
  4. Upload or generate a 3D model, configure the viewer settings, and save the product.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I upload my own 3D models?

Yes. Compatible 3D models can be uploaded without using AI credits.

Do I need AI credits?

AI credits are only required for AI-generated models.

Is the gallery mobile friendly?

Yes. The gallery is fully responsive and supports touch gestures.

Does the plugin support AR?

Yes. The plugin supports AR on compatible Android and iOS devices.

Is Android AR free?

Yes. AR usage on supported Android devices does not deduct AI credits.

Does iOS AR use AI credits?

Yes. iOS AR uses Apple Quick Look and requires USDZ processing. AI credits are deducted when the USDZ model is generated or processed for iOS AR.

Does AR work on every device?

AR availability depends on the device, browser, operating system, and supported AR capabilities. Compatible Android devices use supported Android AR functionality, while compatible iOS devices use Apple Quick Look.
